system.description:
Glimpses beyond the now—insight into futures or echoes of the past. GM sets clarity.

  • Level 1: See a few seconds ahead / 1 minute past
  • Level 2: See 1 minute ahead / 1 hour past
  • Level 3: See 10 minutes ahead / 1 day past
  • Level 4: See 1 hour ahead / 1 week past
  • Level 5: See 1 day ahead / 1 month past
  • Level 6: See 1 week ahead / 1 year past
